resolution_notes: base_url: verifier A is correct. Amber's official OpenAPI specification declares https://api.amber.com.au/v1 as its server, so the directory base is https://api.amber.com.au: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/amberelectric/public-api/main/swagger.json. example: corrected to that server's authenticated GET /sites endpoint; the same official specification defines Bearer authentication, /sites, and its array-of-Site response schema. Amber's current help page also directs customers to its REST API documentation: https://help.amber.com.au/hc/en-us/articles/360038985552-Do-you-have-an-API
